title: verbena aspera var. longidentata
intro: Verbena aspera var. longidentata, commonly known as the Brazilian verbena or Brazilian verbena longidentata, is a plant species within the Verbenaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues, wounds, and skin problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Verbena aspera var. longidentata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
